summary: Measure browser reload, conversation data-ready and painted UX with end-to-end trace propagation and early roster connection

replay.detail: No event replay or claim behavior changes.

schema.detail: No durable schema or migration changes. Trace context is optional transport metadata.

rules.detail: No daemon checkpoint or fleet rules change.

compatibility.detail: Legacy daemons ignore the optional subscribe-frame trace field. Browser HTTP and WebSocket upgrades continue through validated gateway trace parents. Transcript paint and send-echo completion remain feature-owned hooks; this stack emits real conversation data-ready observations without fabricating a painted transcript.

downtime.detail: Normal browser reload adopts a page-owned early roster socket; no persistent socket or cache state is introduced.

manual.detail: Dogfood sampling is 100% of pages, including cheap budget roots and SDK detail. Feature renderers call transcriptCommitted after DOM commit; composer implementations complete beginSendEcho only on a verified matching echo commit.

recovery.detail: Reloading the previous frontend removes page-local bootstrap and tracing behavior; no persistent state requires recovery.
